legend: Students participating in the ICPC are sitting evenly spaced around a round table for lunch. Each student has one catered lunch box. There are various types of lunch boxes, and not all students necessarily have the same type. The number of the students is even. Thus, for each student, there is exactly one student on the directly opposite seat of the table. The number of lunch boxes of each type is even.

As the lunch box on the seat directly opposite is easily visible, a student may feel envious if it is not of the same type as that student's own. Therefore, you want each pair of students sitting opposite each other to have the same type of lunch boxes. As the number of lunch boxes of each type is even, such an arrangement is always possible. To rearrange the lunch boxes, you repeat the following operation any number of times: select any pair of adjacent students and have them exchange their lunch boxes. Find the minimum number of such operations required to achieve the goal.
input: The input consists of at most 5×104$$$5 \times 10^4$$$ test cases, each in the following format.

Each test case consists of two lines. The first line contains an integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤2×105),$$$(2 \leq n \leq 2 \times 10^5),$$$ meaning that there are 2n$$$2n$$$ students at the lunch table. The second line contains 2n$$$2n$$$ integers a1,…,a2n.$$$a_1, \ldots, a_{2n}.$$$ The i$$$i$$$-th integer ai$$$a_i$$$ denotes the type of lunch box initially held by the i$$$i$$$-th student (i=1,…,2n),$$$(i=1,\ldots, 2n),$$$ where the students are numbered clockwise around the table from a specific position. Each integer ai$$$a_i$$$ is between 1$$$1$$$ and n,$$$n,$$$ inclusive. For any integer j,$$$j,$$$ the number of indices i$$$i$$$ such that ai=j$$$a_i=j$$$ is guaranteed to be even.
The end of the input is indicated by a line consisting only of a zero. The sum of n$$$n$$$ over all the test cases does not exceed 2×105.$$$2 \times 10^5.$$$
output: For each test case, output in a line the minimum number of operations required to achieve the goal.
note: For the first test case, swapping the 1 at the seventh position with the 3 in the next position results in 4 2 3 4 1 2 3 1, and then swapping the 1 at the eighth position with the 4 at the first position results in 1 2 3 4 1 2 3 4. After these two swaps, all the pairs of lunch boxes at the direct opposite seats are of the same type. Since the goal cannot be achieved with a single swap, the answer is 2.

legend.ai: 参加 ICPC 的学生围坐在一张圆桌旁，彼此之间的间距相等。每位学生都有一个配餐盒。配餐盒有多种类型，学生们拿到的类型不一定相同。学生人数为偶数。因此，对于每位学生，桌边正对面的座位上恰好有一位学生。每种类型的配餐盒数量都是偶数。
由于正对面座位上的配餐盒很容易被看到，如果它与某位学生自己的配餐盒类型不同，该学生可能会感到羡慕。因此，你希望每一对正对面而坐的学生拥有相同类型的配餐盒。由于每种类型的配餐盒数量都是偶数，这样的安排总是可以实现的。为了重新安排配餐盒，你可以重复任意次执行以下操作：选择一对相邻的学生，让他们交换自己的配餐盒。请你求出实现目标所需的最少操作次数。

input.ai: 输入至多包含 5×104$$$5 \times 10^4$$$ 个测试用例，每个测试用例如下所示。

每个测试用例由两行组成。第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤2×105),$$$(2 \leq n \leq 2 \times 10^5),$$$ 表示午餐桌旁有 2n$$$2n$$$ 名学生。第二行包含 2n$$$2n$$$ 个整数 a1,…,a2n。$$$a_1, \ldots, a_{2n}.$$$ 第 i$$$i$$$ 个整数 ai$$$a_i$$$ 表示第 i$$$i$$$ 名学生最初拿着的午餐盒类型(i=1,…,2n)，$$$(i=1,\ldots, 2n),$$$ 其中学生从某个特定位置开始，按照顺时针方向围绕桌子编号。每个整数 ai$$$a_i$$$ 都在 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n,$$$ 之间(含端点)。对于任意整数 j$$$j,$$$，满足 ai=j$$$a_i=j$$$ 的下标 i$$$i$$$ 的数量保证为偶数。
输入以一行只包含零的行表示结束。所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 2×105。$$$2 \times 10^5.$$$

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一行达到目标所需的最少操作次数。

note.ai: 对于第一个测试用例，将第七个位置上的 1 与相邻位置上的 3 交换，得到 4 2 3 4 1 2 3 1；然后将第八个位置上的 1 与第一个位置上的 4 交换，得到 1 2 3 4 1 2 3 4。经过这两次交换，正对面座位上的所有午餐盒对都属于同一类型。由于无法通过一次交换达到目标，答案为 2。
